## Natural history notes

A small pyralid moth characterized by pale tan to brown wings marked with ornate, scroll-like dark lines and patches that create a finely patterned appearance. In Florida, it is found in wetlands, marsh edges, ponds, canals, swamps, and other humid habitats with aquatic or semi-aquatic vegetation. Adults are mostly nocturnal and may come to lights, while the caterpillars are associated with aquatic plants, feeding within or among leaves and stems and helping connect wetland vegetation with the broader insect food web.
